correctness.rationale: Exact matching–ballot criterion and finite reflection count checked independently on all words through 10 vertices. The beta-binomial word law, formula for the endpoint variance, and the algebraic error bound were reconstructed. A joint beta-normal/conditional-binomial normal limit, valid for arbitrary relative growth, plus uniform integrability gives the absolute first moment and leading constant. All 8620 embedded finite assertions passed; numerical tests are not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A perfect matching is a natural structural event whose probability changes under positive reinforcement even with unchanged one-draw marginals. The theorem identifies the sharp n versus concentration boundary and explicit universal constant for every intermediate and oscillating regime. Neither previously known independent-graph asymptotic nor fixed-urn persistence captures this effective-size transition.
